purpose: Fictional demo portraits for the Marinaro Digital Studio team page, to be replaced with the real founders’ photographs.

images.prompt: Create a single premium editorial team portrait cutout for a modern independent web design studio. A fictional adult man in his early 30s with short softly wavy dark hair, subtle stubble, expressive natural face, wearing a plain charcoal crewneck t-shirt, waist-up frontal three-quarter portrait, relaxed shoulders, slight off-center head tilt and a warm spontaneous smile, quietly playful and approachable not a corporate stock pose. Both shoulders fully inside the image, enough chest visible; centered subject fills frame. Beautiful natural soft studio photography, authentic skin texture, refined neutral color grading, crisp silhouette and hair edges. Completely transparent background with real alpha; no shadows outside the person, no background scenery, no objects, no logos, no text, no frame, no graphic shapes. This is an explicitly illustrative demo portrait, not a depiction of an actual company founder. Square 1024 image; leave small transparent margin around top and shoulders.
images.processing: WebP encoding and responsive resizing; transparency preserved.
